_READ_THIS_FIRST: ILLUSTRATIVE DEFAULTS — deliberately conservative, NOT tuned for you. Every number below should be replaced before arming. An unexamined limit is not a limit.
_known_behaviour: A position is not force-exited automatically: there are no stop orders (a stop is a second, unreviewed order). Protection comes from daily_loss_cap, which sees BOTH realized and unrealized loss, and from exits never being blocked by min_hold when a position is losing. Understand that combination before arming.
_daily_note: Churn limit, not a loss limit. Costs, not bad prediction, killed most strategies in the literature this design is built on.
_loss_note: A FRACTION of the account, not all of it. A cap equal to the balance halts only after the money is gone. Counts realized + unrealized.
_allowlist_note: Start narrow. An empty list is NOT 'allow everything' — a missing or empty allowlist fails closed.
_blackout_note: The first minutes carry the widest spreads. 15 is the conservative default.
_hold_note: Anti-churn only. It never blocks the exit of a losing position.
_fee_note: MEASURE this for your own broker and symbols; do not inherit it. A cost figure carried over from unrelated research was once 9x too high here and silently killed every idea at the gate before analysis began.

session._note: Entries stop at end minus min_hold so nothing is opened that cannot be closed.
